note: YC hint confirmed: YC directory lists Docker (Summer 2010 batch, status Active, website http://docker.com), the same company/domain behind Docker Cloud Sandboxes. Docker was founded as dotCloud; it sold its enterprise business in 2019 and refocused on the developer product (Docker Desktop/Hub, and now Docker Cloud Sandboxes, launched 2026-09-24). Funding/revenue figures above are for Docker, Inc. as a whole (post-2019 restructuring), not broken out for the Cloud Sandboxes product specifically; no funding round or revenue figure has been found since March 2022 as of this check.
